correctness.rationale: Three positive points condition the two-line class to Ldim<=2: collinear forces one complete line; noncollinear gives at most three covering hypotheses on positive off-side queries and one pencil on positive side queries. Predict previously observed positives as 1 and all new points as 0 until three distinct positives, then use an optimal restricted learner: <=3+2=5 mistakes. For every q>=4 the selected two-axis five-point bow-tie is shattered, with all label-cardinality cases covered and a nonparallel cross matching chosen by excluding at most one direction. Orders 2 and 3 have complete finite recurrence certificates (4 and 54 distinct concepts, ranks 1 and 4), and independent explicit lower-trace witnesses. The bundled verifier independently recomputes ranks 1,4,5,5 through q=5 using an exact recurrence with sound pruning.

value.rationale: A sharp, order-independent, online mistake bound for ORs of two geometric predicates is a natural and nonroutine sharpening of the general composition theorem. It works even for non-Desarguesian planes, and gives the exact exceptional small-order transition. The intrinsic three-positive reduction is an explanatory structural lemma; exact q=3 checks are not substitutes for this all-order proof.
